notes: P5 input, not a P5 result: no gate is evaluated here.
SiN is ~9.6x less width-sensitive than Si. G1 removed the numerical case for switching platform; this is a physical one.
The epsilon relaxation widens the linewidth 4.6x and therefore relaxes the tolerance requirement by the same factor.
Even so, 1 nm of width error is ~25 linewidths on SiN at the working Q: active trim is part of the architecture.
Thermal trim shares a channel with the thermal dynamics the design intends to use; P2 must separate them.
